segments.he:
א.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לִבְכּוֹת, יִסְתַּכֵּל עַל הָרָקִיעַ, כִּי הוּא גָּרַם בְּכִיָּה לַמַּיִם.
segments.en: Someone who cannot cry should look at the sky, for it caused the water to cry .
Someone who cannot cry should look at the sky, for it caused the water to cry .

segments.he:
ג.

סְגֻלָּה לְחוֹלֵי הַצַּוָּאר, שֶׁיִּבְכֶּה עַל חֻרְבַּן הַבֵּית-הַמִּקְדָּשׁ.
segments.en:
Crying annuls promiscuous thoughts.

A segulah for healing sicknesses of the neck is to cry over the destruction of the Temple.
